question: To which of the following states does the ‘Khuallam’ folk dance belong?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• During a special occasion called Khuangchawi, the **Khuallam **dance is performed by the local performers of **Mizoram**.

 
 
• The term Khuallam means dance of guests.
 
• people invited to view the performan
